official_sources.source_identity: Gravity Flow changelog; 3.1.1.1 latest stable entry plus intervening 3.1.1 entry

capability_observations.summary: The intervening 3.1.1 release explicitly changes GravityView integration to address deprecated filters used for Workflow Detail and Approval Links. This is an ecosystem integration change, not proof of a PersianGravity regression or repair.

PersianGravity's four Entry Detail workflow-info dates intentionally retain an exact Owner-supplied Gravity Flow package gate because the shared date-format seam lacks semantic row identity. If the Owner supplies 3.1.1.1, that exact package should follow the existing CURRENT_METHOD_STILL_VALID / SAFE_REPLACEMENT_FOUND / NO_SAFE_PATH_PROVEN requalification protocol.
